scripts.build:all: npm run build:api && npm run build:react
scripts.build:deploy: npm --prefix cardmarketing run build && npm --prefix PaymentApi run build
scripts.start:deploy: NODE_ENV=production APP_ENV=production npm --prefix PaymentApi run db:migrate && NODE_ENV=production APP_ENV=production npm --prefix PaymentApi run start

scriptDescriptions.dev: Starts PaymentApi first, waits for /health, then starts the React dev server with NODE_ENV=development.
scriptDescriptions.dev:*: Starts the full solution in the selected env: local, development, or production.
scriptDescriptions.up: One-line startup command: runs MongoDB migration, starts PaymentApi, waits for /health, then starts React.
scriptDescriptions.up:*: One-line startup command for the selected env: local, development, or production.
scriptDescriptions.run:*: Starts the full solution in run mode with the selected env: local, development, or production.
scriptDescriptions.api:dev:*: Starts only PaymentApi in dev mode with the selected env.
scriptDescriptions.api:run:*: Starts only PaymentApi in run mode with the selected env.
scriptDescriptions.react:dev:*: Starts only cardmarketing in Vite dev mode with the selected env.
scriptDescriptions.react:run:*: Starts only cardmarketing in Vite preview mode with the selected env.
scriptDescriptions.ollama:pull: Pulls the default local Ollama model: qwen2.5:7b.
scriptDescriptions.build:all: Builds/checks both projects in order: PaymentApi, then cardmarketing.
